comments.text: The Terror is one of the greatest & grimmest shows I've watched. It's an underrated brand of survival horror while the music adds to the haunting isolation of the cast

comments.author: @nelljehu1280
comments.text: I'm not a horror fan, but I soldiered through this because of the quality of the story, the actors, and a compulsion not unlike the explorers themselves! I could not stop watching. This is true horror both psychological and existential. I still get creeped out just remembering certain scenes from this series. Top shelf.

comments.author: @williamm374
comments.text: This is simply an amazing series. As an old scholar of Arctic exploration, there are so many incredible details in this series, dead on accurate. For someone interested in the Franklin Expedition, this show was a dream come to life. 100% extraordinary series.

comments.author: @MelliaBoomBot
comments.text: Watched this a few days ago. All 10 episodes at 44 mins each in three sittings. Bloody wonderful. For me it was many things, ok it's about being persued by something of the night but also about endurance, your mettel, your health, what you eat, how you treat others, friendship, respect, decisions, leadership.....so amazing...loved loved it.

comments.text: Jared Harris is really getting typecast as "the guy everyone should be listening to that no one is listening to" huh?

comments.author: @jaxn13
comments.text: I’d say this is the greatest show I’ve ever seen. I can confidently say that. Watched it years ago and it stuck with me. Just rewatched it and whoa. It was like the first time again. Absolutely brilliant. The screen writing, the music. The vibe, the history. Even the creative liberties. Everything was masterfully done.
